known_limitations: The registry is a derived operational aggregation and intentionally does not create governance or replace authoritative source artifacts.
Search and Mission Control integration are supported by structured output and source links, but no new Mission Control UI wiring was added in this work package.
summary: Implemented and refreshed a read-only Estate Capability Registry that aggregates capability records, providers, services, lifecycle and operational validation metadata, dependencies, missing metadata warnings, and source artifact links without changing authoritative registries.
